candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return the zero address instead of the stored _owner.
Change owner() to return the msg.sender rather than the stored _owner.
Change owner() to return the contract's own address instead of the stored _owner.
Removed the require that new owner is non-zero, allowing transferOwnership to set owner to zero without reverting.
Added an extra check preventing transferring ownership to the current owner, reverting if attempted.
Changed onlyOwner modifier to allow calls from the zero address (bypassing ownership check when msg.sender is address(0)).
Replace assignment to operator with assigning the zero address, so setOperator always sets operator to address(0) regardless of input.
Replace assignment to operator with assigning msg.sender, so setOperator sets operator to the caller instead of the provided address.
Change onlyOwner to check caller equals zero address, effectively preventing owner from calling setOperator and so setOperator calls will revert unless owner is zero address.
Replace assignment to rewardsRecipient with assigning to a different state variable (operator), so setRewardsRecipient sets operator instead of rewardsRecipient.
Replace assignment to rewardsRecipient with setting it to the zero address, ignoring the provided argument.
Replace assignment to rewardsRecipient with setting it to the caller (msg.sender) instead of the provided argument.
Modify onlyOwner check to compare owner() to tx.origin instead of msg.sender, potentially allowing setRewardsRecipient to be callable by different accounts.
Remove the owner check so onlyOwner becomes a no-op, allowing anyone to call setRewardsRecipient and thus change rewardsRecipient.
